To report a post, comment, or message, o.af: Om 'n plasing, opmerking of boodskap aan te meld, open dit en kies Rapporteer in die kieslys (⋯). Verslae gaan na ons vertroue- en veiligheidspan.
To report a post, comment, or message, o.zu: Ukubika okuthunyelwe, ukuphawula noma umlayezo, uvule bese ukhetha Bika kwimenyu (⋯). Imibiko iya eqenjini lethu lokuthembeka nokuphepha.
To report a post, comment, or message, o.xh: Ukubika iposti, ingxelo okanye umyalezo, uyivule uze ukhethe uXela kwimenyu (⋯). Iingxelo ziya kwiqela lethu lokuthembeka nokhuseleko.
To report a post, comment, or message, o.st: Ho tlaleha poso, maikutlo kapa molaetsa, e bula ebe o khetha Tlaleha ho menu (⋯). Ditlaleho di ya sehlopheng sa rona sa tšhepo le polokeho.
To report a post, comment, or message, o.nso: Go begela poso, maikutlo goba molaetsa, e bula gomme o kgethe Begela go menu (⋯). Dipego di ya sehlopheng sa rena sa tshepo le polokeho.
To report a post, comment, or message, o.tn: Go begela poso, maikutlo kgotsa molaetsa, e bula mme o tlhophe Begela mo menu (⋯). Dipego di ya sehlopheng sa rona sa tshepo le tshireletso.
To report a post, comment, or message, o.ts: Ku tlalela poso, mavonelo kumbe rungula, pfule u hlawula Ripota eka menu (⋯). Swiviko swi ya eka ntlawa wa hina wa vutihlamuleri na vuhlayiseki.
To report a post, comment, or message, o.ve: U report poso, comment kana message, i open u dzhene Report kha menu (⋯). Ma report a ya tshigwada tshashu tsha vhutshilo na tsireledzo.
To report a post, comment, or message, o.ss: Kubika post, comment noma umlayeto, uvule bese ukhetha Bika kumenyu (⋯). Imibiko iya eqenjini lethu letetsembekile nasekuphepheni.
To report a post, comment, or message, o.fr: Pour signaler une publication, un commentaire ou un message, ouvrez-le et choisissez Signaler dans le menu (⋯). Les signalements vont à notre équipe confiance et sécurité.
To report a post, comment, or message, o.ar: للإبلاغ عن منشور أو تعليق أو رسالة، افتحه واختر «إبلاغ» من القائمة (⋯). تُرسل البلاغات إلى فريق الثقة والسلامة.

Some options are managed automatically f.af: Sommige opsies word outomaties bestuur vir rekeninge ouderdom 13–17 om jou ervaring ouderdomstoepaslik te hou.
Some options are managed automatically f.zu: Ezinye izinketho zilawulwa ngokuzenzakalelayo kuma-akhawunti eminyaka engu-13–17 ukuze isipiliyoni sakho sihambisane neminyaka.
Some options are managed automatically f.xh: Ezinye iinketho zilawulwa ngokuzenzekelayo kwiakhawunti zeminyaka engama-13–17 ukuze amava akho ahambelane neminyaka.
Some options are managed automatically f.st: Dikgetho tse ding di laolwa ka bo eona bakeng sa li-account tsa lilemo tsa 13–17 ho boloka boiphihlelo ba hao bo loketseng lilemo.
Some options are managed automatically f.nso: Dikgetho tse dingwe di laolwa ka boiketsetso bakeng sa di-account tša mengwaga ya 13–17 go boloka maitemogelo a gago a loketšego mengwaga.
Some options are managed automatically f.tn: Dikgetho tse dingwe di laolwa ka tsela e itiragatsang mo di-akhaonteng tsa dingwaga tsa 13–17 go boloka maitemogelo a gago a loketseng dingwaga.
Some options are managed automatically f.ts: Swikhetho swin'wana swi lawuriwa hi ku tirhisiwa ka xiyimo xa swona eka ti-account ta malembe ya 13–17 ku hlayisa ntokoto wa wena lowu faneleke malembe.
Some options are managed automatically f.ve: Zwiitwa zwiṅwe zwi langwa nga u ita kha dzi-account dza miaka ya 13–17 u thusa u vhulunga nḓila yawe yo fanelaho miaka.
Some options are managed automatically f.ss: Tinkheto letinye tilawulwa ngokuzenzakalela kuma-akhawunti eminyaka lemu-13–17 kute sive sive sakho sihambisane neminyaka.
Some options are managed automatically f.fr: Certaines options sont gérées automatiquement pour les comptes de 13 à 17 ans afin de garder une expérience adaptée à l’âge.
Some options are managed automatically f.ar: تُدار بعض الخيارات تلقائياً للحسابات من 13 إلى 17 عاماً للحفاظ على تجربة مناسبة للعمر.

Your plan payment was confirmed. Continu.xh: Intlawulo yeplani yakho iqinisekisiwe. Qhubeka uye kwiziko lokuseta ukuze ugqibeze ukusungula ishishini lakho kwi-Beautonomi.
Your plan payment was confirmed. Continu.st: Tefo ya moralo oa hau e netefalitsoe. Tsoela pele ho hub ea ho theha ho qetela ho qala khoebo ea hau ho Beautonomi.
Your plan payment was confirmed. Continu.nso: Tefo ya leano la gago e netefaditšwe. Tšwela pele go hub ya peakanyo go fela go thoma kgwebo ya gago go Beautonomi.
Your plan payment was confirmed. Continu.tn: Tefo ya leano la gago e netefaditswe. Tswela pele go hub ya peakanyo go fetsa go simolola kgwebo ya gago mo Beautonomi.
Your plan payment was confirmed. Continu.ts: Hakelo ya pulanu ya wena yi tiyisisiwile. Yisa eka hub ya ku veka ku heta ku sungula bindzu ra wena eka Beautonomi.

Your plan payment was confirmed. Continu.fr: Votre paiement d’abonnement est confirmé. Continuez vers le hub de configuration pour finaliser le lancement de votre activité sur Beautonomi.

Go to setup hub.ts: Yisa eka hub ya ku veka

Our trust & safety team will review your.af: Ons vertroue- en veiligheidspan sal jou verslag hersien. Ons kan jou kontak as ons meer inligting nodig het.
Our trust & safety team will review your.zu: Iqembu lethu lokuthembeka nokuphepha lizobuyekeza umbiko wakho. Singase sikuthinte uma sidinga olunye ulwazi.
Our trust & safety team will review your.xh: Iqela lethu lokuthembeka nokhuseleko liya kujonga ingxelo yakho. Sinokukuthinta ukuba sifuna ulwazi olungakumbi.
Our trust & safety team will review your.st: Sehlopha sa rona sa tšhepo le polokeho se tla hlahloba tlaleho ea hau. Re ka u ikopanya haeba re hloka lintlha tse ling.
Our trust & safety team will review your.nso: Sehlopha sa rena sa tshepo le polokeho se tla sekaseka pegelo ya gago. Re ka go kgokaganya ge re nyaka tshedimošo e oketšegilego.
Our trust & safety team will review your.tn: Sehlopha sa rona sa tshepo le tshireletso se tla sekaseka pegelo ya gago. Re ka go kgokaganya fa re tlhoka tshedimosetso e e oketsegileng.
Our trust & safety team will review your.ts: Ntlawa wa hina wa vutihlamuleri na vuhlayiseki wu ta languta xiviko xa wena. Hi nga ku hlanga loko hi lava vuxokoxoko byin'wana.
Our trust & safety team will review your.ve: Tshigwada tshashu tsha vhutshilo na tsireledzo tshi do sedzulusa report yawe. Nga ri sa khou toda mafhungo añeḓiwa.
Our trust & safety team will review your.ss: Liqembu letfu lekutetsembekile nasekuphepheni litawubuyekeza umbiko wakho. Singakutsinta uma sidzinga lwati lolunyenti.
Our trust & safety team will review your.fr: Notre équipe confiance et sécurité examinera votre signalement. Nous pourrons vous contacter si nous avons besoin de précisions.
Our trust & safety team will review your.ar: سيراجع فريق الثقة والسلامة بلاغك. قد نتواصل معك إذا احتجنا مزيداً من المعلومات.

Don't know their handle? Open a Partner.af: Ken jy nie hul @handle nie? Open eerder 'n Partner-ondersteuningskaartjie
Don't know their handle? Open a Partner.zu: Awuyazi i-@handle yabo? Vula itikithi lokusekela lwe-Partner esikhundleni salokho
Don't know their handle? Open a Partner.xh: Awuyazi i-@handle yabo? Vula itikiti yenkxaso ye-Partner endaweni yoko
Don't know their handle? Open a Partner.st: Ha o tsebe @handle ea bona? Bula tekete ea tšehetso ea Partner ho e-na le moo
Don't know their handle? Open a Partner.nso: Ga o tsebe @handle ya bona? Bula thekethe ya thekgo ya Partner go e na le moo
Don't know their handle? Open a Partner.tn: Ga o itse @handle ya bone? Bula thekethe ya thuso ya Partner go e na le moo
Don't know their handle? Open a Partner.ts: A wu tivi @handle ya vona? Pfule thikithi ya nseketelo wa Partner endhawini yaleyo
Don't know their handle? Open a Partner.ve: A u divhi @handle yawe? Vula thikithi ya thuso ya Partner fhano ndi hone
Don't know their handle? Open a Partner.ss: Awuyati @handle yabo? Vula itikithi lesekela le-Partner esikhundleni salokho
Don't know their handle? Open a Partner.fr: Vous ne connaissez pas l’identifiant ? Ouvrez plutôt un ticket d’assistance Partenaire
Don't know their handle? Open a Partner.ar: لا تعرف المعرّف؟ افتح تذكرة دعم للشركاء بدلاً من ذلك

Verify your identity to view and change.fr: Vérifiez votre identité pour afficher et modifier les paramètres de contenu et de sécurité.
Verify your identity to view and change.ar: تحقق من هويتك لعرض وتغيير إعدادات المحتوى والسلامة.

Settings marked as managed cannot be cha.fr: Les paramètres marqués comme gérés ne peuvent pas être modifiés pour votre tranche d’âge.
Settings marked as managed cannot be cha.ar: لا يمكن تغيير الإعدادات المُدارة تلقائياً لفئتك العمرية.

Reports go to our trust & safety queue..af: Verslae gaan na ons vertroue- en veiligheid-waglys. Sluit in wie jy aanmeld en wat gebeur het. Dringende gevaar? Bel eers nooddienste, kontak dan Partner-ondersteuning.
Reports go to our trust & safety queue..zu: Imibiko iya ohlwini lwethu lokuthembeka nokuphepha. Faka ukuthi ubani obikayo nokwenzekile. Usongo oluphuthumayo? Shaya amaphoyisa/ezokuphepha kuqala, bese uxhumana nosekelo lwe-Partner.
Reports go to our trust & safety queue..xh: Iingxelo ziya kuluhlu lwethu lokuthembeka nokhuseleko. Bandakanya ukuba ubani obikayo nokwenzekileyo. Ingozi ephuthumayo? Tsalela iinkonzo eziphuthumayo kuqala, emva koko uqhagamshelane nenkxaso ye-Partner.
Reports go to our trust & safety queue..st: Litlaleho li ea moleng oa rona oa tšhepo le polokeho. Kenyelletsa motho eo u mo tlalehileng le se etsahetseng. Kotsi e potlakileng? Letsetsa litšebeletso tsa tshohanyetso pele, ebe o ikopanya le tšehetso ea Partner.
Reports go to our trust & safety queue..nso: Dipego di ya go lebati la rena la tshepo le polokeho. Akaretša gore o begela mang le seo se diregilego. Kotsi e bonagalago? Letsetša ditirelo tša tshohanyetso pele, gomme o kgokaganye le thekgo ya Partner.
Reports go to our trust & safety queue..tn: Dipego di ya mo lebatsong la rona la tshepo le tshireletso. Akaretsa gore o begela mang le se se diragetseng. Kotsi e e bonagalang? Letsetsa ditirelo tsa tshohanyetso pele, mme o kgokaganye le thuso ya Partner.
Reports go to our trust & safety queue..ts: Swiviko swi ya eka layini wa hina wa vutihlamuleri na vuhlayiseki. Hlanganisa loko u ri karhi u vika na leswi endlekaka. Khombo ro hatlisa? Tshama u ri karhi u fonela tisebele ta xihatla, u tlhela u hlangana na nseketelo wa Partner.
Reports go to our trust & safety queue..ve: Ma report a ya kha layini yawe ya vhutshilo na tsireledzo. Dzhenisa ani a u reporta na zwo itea. Khombo i re hone? Fonelani tshitshavha tsha u thusa u thoma, u fhedzele u kwama thuso ya Partner.
Reports go to our trust & safety queue..ss: Imibiko iya ohlwini lwetfu lekutetsembekile nasekuphepheni. Faka kutsi ngubani lobikako nalekwentekile. Ingozi lephutfumako? Bitana tinsita letiphutfumako kuqala, bese uxhumana ne-Partner support.
Reports go to our trust & safety queue..fr: Les signalements vont à notre file confiance et sécurité. Indiquez qui vous signalez et ce qui s’est passé. Danger urgent ? Appelez d’abord les urgences, puis contactez l’assistance Partenaire.
Reports go to our trust & safety queue..ar: تُرسل البلاغات إلى قائمة الثقة والسلامة. اذكر من تبلّغ عنه وما حدث. خطر عاجل؟ اتصل بالطوارئ أولاً، ثم تواصل مع دعم الشركاء.
